title: feat(app-shell): register the ref:dataset spec-form widget, fed by the report inspector's dataset catalog (objectui#11601)
body:
Fixes #11601
Clause-②: yes (widening). `SchemaForm` is exported from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, and its `widgetContext` prop type `WidgetContext` gains one optional member, `datasets`. Measured on the built `dist`: `index.d.ts` exports `SchemaForm`, `SchemaForm.d.ts` declares `widgetContext?: WidgetContext`, and `widgets.d.ts` now declares `datasets?: LoadState` of `DatasetCatalogEntry[]` beside `objectNames` (the positive control). The member is additive and optional, so no code that type-checked before stops type-checking. The claim's `no` counted the index's metadata-admin exports as the page components and did not count the `SchemaForm` re-export. The changeset is `minor` for the same reason.

## What this does

`ref:dataset` is a widget hint the spec already declares (the report form's top-level `dataset`), but `WIDGETS` had no renderer for it. `resolveFieldFace` therefore sent a field declaring it to the announced raw-JSON face: a JSON textarea under "widget ref:dataset — falling back to JSON until a custom renderer is registered." This PR registers that renderer.

- **`RefDatasetWidget`** in `widgets.tsx`, registered in `WIDGETS` as `ref:dataset` and declared `'control'` in `WIDGET_LABELLING`. It reads the catalog from a new optional `WidgetContext.datasets` (a `LoadState` of the catalog entries), the same way `ref:object` and `view-ref` take theirs. It handles the four catalog states as `RefObjectWidget` does:
  - **failed**: the shared `PickerLoadFailure` notice (`ref-dataset-load-failed`) beside a text box that stays editable;
  - **loading**: the stored name in a disabled box;
  - **idle** (no host feeds a catalog), or a completed load with no datasets: a labelled text input that writes the typed name. Never the raw-JSON face;
  - **loaded**: a `Select` over `datasetSelectOptions`, which shows `LABEL (name)` and then ` — description` (the objectui#11161 author text). It writes the dataset **name**. A stored name that the catalog does not offer stays as its own option, flagged through `engine.form.flaggedValue` and `engine.form.notFound`, so it is not blanked and does not look like an offered dataset.
- **`inspectors/dataset-picker-options.ts`** (new, pure): `labelBesideName` and `datasetPickerOptions` moved here unchanged from `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, plus `datasetSelectOptions`, the select-item text form the inspector already built inline. Importing them from the inspector would have created a cycle: the inspector renders `SchemaForm`, which imports the widget registry. The inspector re-exports `datasetPickerOptions` for `DashboardWidgetInspector`, which imports it from there. There is one definition.
- **`ReportDefaultInspector`** passes its existing `useDatasetCatalog` result to the spec form as `widgetContext.datasets`, built with `mapLoaded(rosterFrom(...))` so a failure is read before loading, as for its own pickers. `conditionScope` is required on every `WidgetContext`. This PR states `'none'`, which is the `report` row of `CONDITION_SCOPE_BY_METADATA_TYPE`. The bundled `ReportSchema` has no key with a predicate-style name (counted over its derived JSON Schema: 73 property paths, none matched), so the report form's existing fields render unchanged.
- No new i18n strings. Every copy is an existing `engine.form.*` key.

## Not an inspector-local override, and this PR alone does not end the joined-block symptom

The "Joined blocks" row spec belongs to objectstack (`reportForm`), and it is the only source of truth for which control a block's `dataset` gets. This PR does not patch that row in the inspector. The bundled `@objectstack/spec` row is still `{ field: 'dataset', label: 'Dataset' }`, so **a joined report's block `dataset` still renders as free text** until objectstack-ai/objectstack#21714 declares `widget: 'ref:dataset'` and `required: true` on the row and that declaration reaches this inspector: through objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin moving past this PR, and, for this repository's own console, through an `@objectstack/spec` release that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#21714. This PR is the widget that row will resolve to. Read alone, it does not end the joined-block symptom on the card. That half belongs to objectstack-ai/objectstack#21714.

Every other `SchemaForm` host leaves `datasets` absent. A field declaring `ref:dataset` there now renders the labelled text input where it rendered the raw-JSON face before. This is pinned below.

`SchemaForm.tsx` is not edited. Both repeater layouts already route a row field's `widget` through `resolveFieldWidget`: the grid cell passes `fieldSpec: s`, and the card row goes through `FieldRow`. The pins below exercise both layouts.

## Tests

Measured at `9ebe77b`, the final commit, unless noted.

- **Reproduced first (red on `b92329c`, before any edit):** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.refDatasetWidget-11601.test.tsx` gave `Tests 9 failed (9)`. Every case found the announced fallback notice and a `textarea`, which is the raw-JSON face.
- **New pins:**
  - `SchemaForm.refDatasetWidget-11601.test.tsx` (9 cases): with a catalog, the picker in a section and in a repeater row (grid and card) writes the dataset name, the options are the author text, and an out-of-catalog stored name stays visible and flagged. With no catalog (no `WidgetContext`, or one without `datasets`), the field degrades to a text input named by its label, in a section and in both repeater layouts, writes the typed name, and shows no raw-JSON face.
  - `inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.blockDatasetPicker-11601.test.tsx` (2 cases): the bundled `reportForm` is mocked with exactly the objectstack-ai/objectstack#21714 declaration added to the joined-blocks `dataset` row. The fixture throws unless it declares exactly one row. The inspector's catalog then reaches the block row's picker, and picking writes `{ ...draft, blocks: [{ name: 'won_deals', dataset: 'support_load' }] }` with nothing else changed.
- **Registry pins updated** (each derives its population from `WIDGET_LABELLING`, so adding the widget requires a row in each): `SchemaForm.widgetLabelling.test.tsx` (a loaded case and a no-catalog case), `SchemaForm.controlWidgetGridNaming-9889.test.tsx` (the grid cell is named by the column header), and `__tests__/SchemaForm.controlWidgetFailureArmNaming-9931.test.tsx` (the failure arm keeps a labelable control in both layouts, the banner ledger reads `ref-dataset-load-failed`, and the loaded leg shows no banner).
- **Scoped suite at `b58a18b`** (the source commit; `9ebe77b` only edits the changeset): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus every test that imports the three edited source files from outside it, or reads them as source text: `spec-symbol-parity`, the four `ReportConfigPanel` / `ReportView` host tests, `view-filter-fold.ratchet` (reads `widgets.tsx`), `packages/core` `column-identity.ratchet` (scans `widgets.tsx` / `SchemaForm.tsx`), and `packages/i18n` `report-editor-retired-4145`. Result: `Test Files 389 passed (389)`, `Tests 4550 passed | 1 skipped (4551)`. Re-run at `9ebe77b` for the two ratchets and the two new pin files: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 27 passed (27)`. The narrowing selected tests by import and by source-text read. Tests that reach these files only transitively (for example the `StudioDesignSurface` suites) were not run locally. CI's `pnpm test` runs them.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` passed, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` passed (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `--listFilesOnly` on the test project lists all five touched test files and the new module.

## Ablations (each one ran on committed `b58a18b` through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which mutates through an anchor that must hit and restores by blob hash)

1. **Delete the `WIDGETS` entry** (anchor 1 to 0, blob `fbfd4a2d90af` to `83ddbf6c965c`): 17 failed and 138 passed across the two new pin files and the three registry pins. Every picker pin and every degrade pin failed, because the field fell back to the raw-JSON face. The registry gates failed ("declares exactly the registered keys", "probes every registered key"), and so did the 9889 and 9931 rows for `ref:dataset`. Restored: blob `fbfd4a2d90af` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. **Remove the catalog from the inspector's context** (anchor 1 to 0, blob `8a6b57240b1d` to `76637674f521`): both inspector picker pins failed (`Unable to find … role "combobox" and name "Dataset"`), and the block row rendered a textbox named "Dataset", which is the degrade face. All 9 `SchemaForm` pins, including the no-catalog degrade pins, stayed green. Restored: blob `8a6b57240b1d` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

All exited 0 at `9ebe77b` unless noted: `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm changeset:check`. These also exited 0 at `b58a18b`: `check:icon-record-names` (it reads `widgets.tsx`), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` (the new test adds a `vi.mock`), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources` (the new module), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:lint-rule-coverage`.

ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the eight touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 8 files linted, 0 errors. Warning counts are unchanged from the base for the two edited source files (3 and 3, 37 and 37). The new files have none. Type-aware linting is not enabled (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, with no `project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the lint verdict of any file it does not touch. CI's `pnpm lint` runs the repo-wide scan.

NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` and `check:sdui-registration-pins`. Reason: both read a built `apps/console` bundle (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`), and a console build was not run locally. The same applies to `check:eager-closure`. CI runs them.

## Acceptance notes

- `RowCell`, the cell renderer inside `master-detail` rows in `widgets.tsx`, special-cases only `ref:object` and `ref:component`. A `ref:dataset` column inside a `master-detail` widget would therefore not render the picker. No producer declares that shape (the joined-blocks row is a `repeater`, which this PR covers), so this is noted here and not filed.
- Docs: no `content/docs` page or package README lists the metadata-admin widget hints, so there is no doc to update.
